newsitem.title: UK: European cotton prices firm in selective buying.
newsitem.headline: European cotton prices firm in selective buying.

text.p: Cotton prices firmed on selective buying in Europe as spinners sought to cover renewed pockets of demand for yarn and cloth, industry sources said.
Buyers' interest continued to focus on Central Asian and West African cottons but Middle Eastern types also entered the frame, they said.
Business in Eastern Europe remains slack due to general economic uncertainty but small quantities of long staple cottons are still being traded, they added.
